other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is calculated on the training set and applied directly to the same training set without using out-of-fold (OOF) predictions. This causes extreme target leakage and overfitting, particularly for high-cardinality features like user IDs.

summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated solution with advanced modeling techniques (MoE neural network and LightGBM) and extensive feature engineering. However, the data preparation suffers from critical target leakage due to in-fold target encoding of high-cardinality features like `user_id`. Additionally, the random train/validation split fails to account for both temporal order and user grouping, which will lead to overly optimistic validation scores.
